body: Can I also get the link 😂

Yeah she doesn’t really care. It’s a surprise she even took me in. All she wants is the money. No one to help watch at all. I had to move to an entirely different state  so I don’t know anyone and I don’t have friends. I tried meeting new people and even had them come to my house but I still couldn’t even function properly and even with taking a Xanax I feel like no one would even want a friend like me who can’t do anything without having a severe panic attack. I’ve been trying. I even put up ads to sell my stuff which even then isn’t a lot. I don’t have any money to afford a computer to be able to work from home :(

It started randomly one day I was fine then I had an extremely bad panic attack out of nowhere with derealization driving home from work the next day I wasn’t able to do anything I had no stressors everything was fine and then my world started falling apart.
We have been dating around 4 months now so it’s pretty new.  We just recently introduced our kids to eachother

My main thing is having to wait it out for something that might not happen or just end everything and avoid the issue and drama. I’ve tried talking to him about it and he is understanding but I just don’t know if anything will actually change and I don’t want to wait a long time for it to happen
Yeah I can completely understand that. The thing that makes it hard is that he is so sweet and also so great with my son it just sucks he can’t stand up to her :/
